title: CareOS source-linked clinical review policy
rules: Every clinical statement used downstream must remain bound to an exact source locator.
An agent or model draft is never promoted to clinical source truth by generation alone.
A named qualified clinician must review a prepared clinical finding before it can pass the human-review gate.
No autonomous diagnosis, treatment decision, order, medication change or clinical write-back is authorized by this policy.
A complete trust chain does not override CareOS clinical production release gates or external regulatory, privacy, security and hospital governance requirements.
